d:
Alakshendr ka dut jangal men tapasviyon se milne aata hai, vah chahta hai ki tapasvi alakshendr se aa kar mile, magar tapasvi to tapasvi thahre unhen na mrityu ka bhay hai na hi alakshendr ka. kya hoga aage jab ye bat alakshendr ko pata chalegi - dekhie is bhag men.
The messenger of Alakshendra comes to meet the ascetics in the forest, he wants the ascetic to come and meet Alakshendra, but the ascetic remains an ascetic, he neither fears death nor of Alakshendra. What will happen next when Alakshendra comes to know about this - see in this part.
